description: Returns the customer's First account details: the legal name, the email, the phone, the partner or the partner invite, and the purchases. Use it when the customer asks about these details. Do not use the email of the AI app account. To change the name, call update_profile. To change the phone, call update_phone. To change a pending partner invite, call update_partner_invite. To change the email, call request_email_change.
name: get_my_details

status.description: joined: only the partner changes the partner details.

pending_email.description: A new email that the customer did not verify yet.

requested_email.description: A new email of request_email_change that the current email did not approve yet.

title: Get the customer's details
